app_info.subtitle: Live web data for AI agents
app_info.description: Context turns the live web and files into clean, agent-ready data inside ChatGPT. Search for current information, read a known page as Markdown, crawl websites, extract schema-shaped JSON, parse documents, retrieve company and brand intelligence, inspect visual design systems, run asynchronous scraping batches across thousands of URLs, and monitor websites for meaningful changes over time. Some scraping tools can perform explicitly requested browser actions to reveal content. Context does not provide general messaging, calendar, account-management, or social-publishing integrations.

test_cases.description: Read a known public documentation page as Markdown and answer from its contents.
test_cases.user_prompt: Read https://docs.context.dev/ and give me a concise overview of the public Context APIs described there. Include the source URL.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the scraped Markdown to summarize the documented Context API categories and includes https://docs.context.dev/ as the source.

test_cases.description: Search the live web when the user needs current information and does not know the source URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find recent official announcements about the Model Context Protocol from the past 30 days. Give me the title, publisher, publication date, and URL for each result, and clearly say if there are no matching official announcements.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant recent results from official sources with titles, publishers, dates, and URLs, or clearly states that no matching official announcements were found.

test_cases.description: Retrieve domain-based brand intelligence and render the app's visual brand card.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the brand profile for stripe.com including its logo, brand colors, and social links.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the Context brand card for stripe.com with the available logo, color palette, company description, social profiles, and links; unavailable fields are omitted rather than invented.

test_cases.description: Extract a small, explicit JSON structure from a public website.
test_cases.user_prompt: From https://docs.context.dev/, extract the top-level documentation sections as JSON. Return an object with a `sections` array; each item must contain a string `title` and string `url`. Do not include sections that are not present on the site.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns valid JSON with a sections array containing only documentation section titles and URLs found on the site.

test_cases.description: Discover a small set of relevant URLs from a public website sitemap without crawling every page body.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find up to 10 API reference URLs from the docs.context.dev sitemap. Return only page titles when available and absolute URLs.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the sitemap tool and returns no more than 10 relevant API-reference URLs from docs.context.dev without inventing pages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Context for private calendar data because the app has no calendar integration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have on my Google Calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no access to calendar or scheduling systems.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Context for outbound email because no tool can send messages.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my team with a summary of today's meeting notes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send emails or messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Context for publishing or editing third-party internet content.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post a tweet announcing our product launch to our company Twitter account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot publish content to social media or any external platform.
